notes: Printed: '{T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.' Your library holds Forest, Island (basic) and Jungle Hollow (nonbasic) under 6 filler cards; the opponent's library holds a Swamp. Activating taps and sacrifices the Wilds; you choose the Island, which enters the battlefield tapped under your control. Forest, Jungle Hollow and the fillers stay in your library (8 cards, order unknown after the shuffle); the opponent's Swamp stays put. (The harness's opening begin_turn draws your top library card before the filler is dealt: the last-listed 'Opening Draw' absorbs that draw.)
